articles.title: Why banks and offshore hubs like Dubai are winners of the Senate killing the Clarity Act
articles.snippet: One expert believes that the failure to pass the bill is a win for the banks that staunchly oppose stablecoin yields, while a global crypto lawyer believes overseas jurisdictions benefit.

articles.title: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent champions dollar dominance across global markets and stablecoins
articles.snippet: Bessent pushed back against a bearish assessment of the U.S. economy highlighting strong growth, foreign demand for American assets and continued dollar dominance.

articles.title: Google and Apple seek crypto talent as Big Tech eyes stablecoin and tokenization rails
articles.snippet: The tech giants’ job listings could indicate that they are separately pursuing experts in stablecoins and tokenized deposits for future projects.

articles.title: Coinbase, Robinhood, Circle could be early winners of SEC's tokenized-stock push, analysts say
articles.snippet: Goldman Sachs and Citizens analysts said the agency's move create new opportunities in custody, tokenization infrastructure and stablecoin settlement, while giving brokers room to expand onchain products.

articles.title: ECB launches Pontes to settle tokenized assets without stablecoins
articles.snippet: Pontes will expand its services and operating hours gradually, with full implementation expected by 2028 and more participants set to join.
